_doc: net-triage eval corpus (2026-09-26). Each scenario = a net-forensics capture + the API state the probes read + ground truth. Captures are the real 2026-09-26 two-node capture, verbatim (live) or with its !! findings stripped (base-healthy) and a fault re-added in the exact line format libexec/net-forensics.sh emits. node 0 = 10.0.148.221, node 1 = 10.0.159.197. gnp = what `kubectl get globalnetworkpolicy deny-direct-ai-vendor-egress -o jsonpath={.spec.selector}{.spec.types}` returns; UNREACHABLE = the API read fails. truth = catalog ids that are real causes; out_of_catalog = a real cause the catalog has no hypothesis for (the tool must abstain); unknown = hypotheses whose evidence was unavailable (must not come back falsified). truth_status: provisional until a fix + verify has proven it.
